exposure: midwifery presence in maternity care teams
cohort: Low-risk parous women in the United States
finding: Parous women receiving care at centers with midwives had significantly higher rates of vaginal birth, including vaginal birth after cesarean, and a lower likelihood of labor induction.
mod_finding: Parous women cared for in centers with midwives have significantly higher rates of vaginal birth, including vaginal birth after cesarean, and lower likelihood of labor induction.
